The '''Feeorin''' were a bipedal [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|sapients]] that spread across the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] after the demise of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], thousands of years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], and established a major colony on [[Odryn]]. Feeorin were quick to anger and highly impersonal. They typically placed their own affairs above others, causing other species to regard them as selfish.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:DreadPirateRav.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Rav, a Feeorin with cybernetics.]]
The average Feeorin had thick tendrils hanging from the backs of their heads (similar to those of the amphibious [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolans]]) and much smaller and thinner ones hanging from their face. They also had mottled skin ranging from yellow to green and blue, with a few individuals even having jet-black or white skin pigmentation. The Feeorin could live for up to four hundred years, and due to a unique metabolism, they grew stronger with age rather than weaker.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" /> Curiously, some Feeorins had noses while others lacked any nasal openings.

==History==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the Feeorin were ruled by the [[Exalted]], the oldest and strongest of the Feeorin Elders. At the time, the title was held by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Feln]], who had defeated all other tribes and united his people. He kept his title even after becoming a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], which allowed the [[Jedi Covenant]] to use the holiest place of the Feeorin, the [[Sanctum of the Exalted]], as a secret facility for the storage and research of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]].

After the demise of [[Odryn]], many of the Feeorin colony [[Starship/Legends|ships]] never reached their destination, and the survivors were seen as raiders and scavengers by the natives of their settled [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. It was apparently rare for Feeorin to become Jedi.

==Society and culture==
[[File:Feeorin_KotORCG.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Feeorin.]]
The Feeorin believed that the spirits of their fallen Elders resided at the Sanctum of the Exalted, where they forged [[Odryn]]'s seasons. Because of this, when the presence of the [[Helm of Dathka Graush]] altered the weather six kilometers around the Sanctum, many believed the dead Elders were angry at the presence of outsiders—non-Feeorin—there. This was also a violation of the [[Rime Feeorin]], the Feeorin's ancient code.
Feeorin mostly had simple names composed of no more than 4 or 5 letters.

==Feeorin in the galaxy==
The most famous members of the Feeorin species were the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] captain [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], who battled the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Karthakk system]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; [[Feln]], leader of the Feeorin during the Mandalorian Wars and a member of the Jedi Covenant; and the pirate [[Rav]], who lived circa [[130 ABY]].
